name: stabilized_steps_hitl
description: HITL counterpart of stabilized_steps (ROADMAP batch 4i). The same Stabilized roll, pitch and yaw stick steps on the same base sticks (the 15 m/s level trim of stabilized_steps, rounded to the 1/1000 MAVLink MANUAL_CONTROL resolution), but entered from the HITL cruise after takeoff (about 25 m/s), so settle_s is longer. hil_bridge/commands/stabilized_steps.py flies it on HITL; run in SITL it previews that flight from a 25 m/s level trim.
